steps: Open a plain-file source and seed matching history.
Append a complete synthetic line.
Assert one published event within the healthy latency target.
Append a UTF-8 sequence and line split over several writes.
Assert no replacement characters or premature complete event.
Complete the line; assert one event at the original byte start.
Pin seed boundary S.
Append while backward seeding is in progress.
Complete any partial line across S.
Assert no source-range gap or duplicate at S.
Rename current file to configured plain rotation.
Append to old open handle, then create/append new active file.
Assert old drain and new-generation events, with correct source state.
Observe baseline file and cursor.
Truncate and append new content.
Assert generation reset and visible continuity warning.
Interrupt test SFTP transport.
Append data and reconnect.
Assert bounded retry, honest gap interval and offset-based recovery where provable.
Acquire matching and nonmatching events into raw buffer.
Change filter without disconnecting.
Assert retained previously hidden events become visible and old-version frames are discarded.
Stop acknowledging/reading frames from one test client.
Continue source acquisition.
Assert bounded memory and a visible reset/gap, not silent loss.
Monitor five sources but append to only one.
Assert the merge buffer does not wait for idle-source watermarks.
Publish a later-timestamp event.
Append an earlier-timestamp event after the reorder window.
Assert a late marker and stable anchored chronological insertion.
